Calendar time at which a number of events is expected

Source: R/ms_event_time.R
ms_event_time.Rd

Solves for the calendar time at which the expected total number of events of an endpoint reaches each target.

Usage

ms_event_time(scenario, n, events, endpoint = c("os", "pfs"))

Arguments

scenario

An ms_scenario object.

n

Total sample size.

events

Target numbers of events (positive).

endpoint

"os" or "pfs".

Value

Numeric vector of calendar times. An error is raised when a target cannot be reached.

See also

ms_events

Examples

ctl <- ms_model(death = log(2) / 12)
trt <- ms_model(death = 0.7 * log(2) / 12)
scn <- ms_scenario(ctl, trt, accrual = ms_accrual(rate = 20))
ms_event_time(scn, n = 400, events = c(150, 300))
#> [1] 20.46883 39.66740
